cards.title: Document / Style
cards.body:
Character lineup model sheet · concept art sheet
#12 · Detailed-Military-Caricature · Metal Slug X / 3
Neo Geo MVS · late 90s
Artist ref: TONKO · SNK illustrator
Signature: energetic military cartooning, dense clear detail

cards.title: Lineart
cards.body:
Rich, deliberate fine contours
Dense micro-detail like arcade sprite art
Keep silhouette clean and readable

cards.title: Morphology
cards.body:
Adult human design stays fixed
Tall, slim ectomorph with long limbs
Parody expression; no bulk transformation

cards.title: Shading
cards.body:
Saturated military greens and rust
Volumetric flame-like cel lighting accents
Identity materials remain recognizable

cards.title: Biotype
cards.body:
Selected: tall, slim ectomorph
Options: ectomorph · mesomorph · endomorph
muscular · petite · slim · athletic · curvy
heavy muscular · short

cards.title: Relative Scale
cards.body:
H = crown-to-chin head height · target ~7.5H
Orthographic views share scale and baseline
Visual guide, not canonical absolute height

cards.title: Palette / Effects
cards.body:
Fixed identity colors: blue/cyan, teal, white, gray, burgundy, brown
Military greens and rust only as restrained style lighting/details
No palette replacement of costume identity

cards.title: Background / Alignment
cards.body:
Clean neutral cream · no scenery or texture
Horizontal lineup · common scale and baseline

cards.title: Fixed Character Details
cards.body:
Gray hair · round brass glasses · cane · rapier
Steel crescent boomerang · fully human; no monster traits

artistic_style_reference.reference_role_and_scope: SNK illustrator with documented Metal Slug series illustration work, especially later-series/promo art; not pixel-sprite authorship for Metal Slug X/3.
style_signature: contrast between sturdy machinery and elastic character acting
artistic_style_reference.basis_and_limits: Use as an illustration reference only; the game’s sprite art is a team achievement.
